note: Canon Ignitions (Fire Force canon abilities). 'categories' fixes fields for every Ignition in a category: every Pillar has an Adolla Burst (Index: Adolla). 'oneUser' categories hold one character each and get their own section in the claim menu. Each Ignition's 'theme' replaces the card's theme box and 'holder' is who has it in canon (shown when the claim has no note). Add a 'generation' (Second, Third or XO) to lock that too. 'look' is the canon card's effect and two colours (burst, split, spark, rise, fall, swirl, streak, pulse, shimmer).
